name: Device Request 9
definition: Specifies the environment, the context and the services to be used with a device request message.

Context.name: Context
Context.definition: Context in which the transaction is performed (payment and sale).

ServiceContent.name: Service Content
ServiceContent.definition: Define the type of service requested.

DisplayRequest.name: Display Request
DisplayRequest.definition: Content of the Display Request message.

InputRequest.name: Input Request
InputRequest.definition: Content of the Input Request message.

PrintRequest.name: Print Request
PrintRequest.definition: Content of the Print Request message.

PlayResourceRequest.name: Play Resource Request
PlayResourceRequest.definition: Content of the Resource Request message.

SecureInputRequest.name: Secure Input Request
SecureInputRequest.definition: Request a secure input for a PIN.

InitialisationCardReaderRequest.name: Initialisation Card Reader Request
InitialisationCardReaderRequest.definition: A service to send parameters to Card Reader to initialize a new communication with a card.

CardReaderAPDURequest.name: Card Reader APDU Request
CardReaderAPDURequest.definition: Content of the APDU (Application Protocol Data Unit) to send to the Card.

PowerOffCardReaderRequest.name: Power Off Card Reader Request
PowerOffCardReaderRequest.definition: Content of the Power Off Card Reader Request message.

TransmissionRequest.name: Transmission Request
TransmissionRequest.definition: Content of the Request message to transmit.

InputNotification.name: Input Notification
InputNotification.definition: Content of the Input notification message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information incorporated as an extension to the message.
